scope: Literature-anchored representative model; neither commercial LPDDR5/6 process reproduction nor calibrated reproduction of the paper

primary_reference.structure: Figure 2(c), conventional asymmetric junction BCAT; no Pi buried insulator

coordinates.z: depth below silicon contact surface, positive downward

geometry.reconstruction_interpretation: Use published recess marker as deepest metal point z=150; this coordinate interpretation is an explicit assumption, not additional information from the paper
geometry.topology: Finite-width extrusion of Figure 2(c) cross-section, STI on both y sides; no claim of reconstructing unreported saddle side gates or adjacent wordlines
geometry.side_boundary: electrically insulating; bottom body contact; no periodic cell array
geometry.size_semantics: Only gate top depth changes; vertical span is not effective channel length, technology node, or lateral gate length
geometry.evidence_class: 80/150 nm and family 70/80/90 nm from paper; all other dimensions and topology completion are declared engineering assumptions
geometry.extension_reason: x boundary expanded before any native run so 30-degree tilt toward SN stays inside Si through z=1000 nm; original +/-250 nm proposal and review retained

doping.profile: ND(x,z)=w(x)*Npk*exp(-(z/aSN)^2)+(1-w(x))*Npk*exp(-(z/aBL)^2); w(x)=(1-tanh(x/5nm))/2; aJ=zJ/sqrt(ln(Npk/NA)); assigned only in silicon
doping.evidence_class: Peak and junction intervals and Gaussian family from paper; interval midpoints, acceptor, exact Gaussian convention and lateral blending are assumptions

materials_and_physics.gate: ideal metal, assumed work function 4.6 eV; transport material mapping must be separately frozen before Geant4 release
materials_and_physics.model_gate: Exact installed-version model names, parameter defaults and units must be exported to a frozen physics manifest before any run; no silent fallback or fitting to radiation response
scientific_limitations: This is a declared local model branch, not a nonlocal-path equivalent or a calibrated reproduction.
A/B and exponent map the 300 K uniform-field phonon-assisted reference only; Fermi statistics, bandgap narrowing and nonuniform fields preclude general equality.
Local generation/recombination lacks path integration, spatially separated electron/hole endpoints and reflection at insulator interfaces.
dDist=dPot=0 retains the installed local defaults; abrupt trench fields and GIDL may have model-form bias of unproven magnitude or sign.
DC, retention, charge collection and upset results remain conditional on this model; subsequent matched model sensitivity is required.
Legal native availability and syntax are unverified until the original SDevice run actually checks out the required features.
required_evidence: Frozen installed-version physics manifest and original successful solver exits
DC and actual two-bit write/read checks under this same physics assumption
Matched model-form sensitivity with final holdout excluded from tuning

circuit.bias_and_capacitance_evidence: Explicit cell-operation assumptions; paper DC drain biases are not claimed to be product supply specifications

timeline_ns.action: WL off; BL driver at bit*VDD; common numerical SN initial value
switch BL to precharge, then isolate driver by 8.1 ns
hold; particle at 15 ns only in signal roles
ramp WL on for charge-sharing read
read, score mean VBL over 21.9 to 22 ns
finish without claiming restored or persistent memory state

alpha.energy_definition: At local silicon surface; no package or orbit spectrum
alpha.azimuth: 180 degrees in x-y convention: tilt toward negative x, away from the buried gate
alpha.regularization_status: Literature order-of-magnitude guided assumptions; parameter mapping and radial heterostructure losses are not calibrated
alpha.native_route: installed-version HeavyIon, PicoCoulomb; positive carrier-pair generation; no PMI dependency
alpha.profile: Integrate NIST ASTAR electronic stopping along E(s); nuclear stopping changes energy loss but is not counted wholesale as electron-hole generation
alpha.cutoff: Finite silicon volume and finite accepted time window; report tail/oxide/domain loss without renormalizing it away
alpha.later_profile_rule: Reintegrate ASTAR for each energy and actual clipped path length; never stretch the normal-incidence 1 um table

numerics.native_field_sampling: Every accepted source-window BE endpoint plus bracketing endpoints; retain rejected-step and rollback facts; no synthetic expected-time fields
